value.text: I'm tracing where ListMemos is handled on the backend—the API handler, the store method, and the SQLite dialect implementation—to verify how they connect.
I want to confirm the store method just delegates to the driver, and that the handler calls store correctly — checking the relevant sections in memo_service.go and store/memo.go for this.
I should note that connect_services.go is the real Connect handler delegating to APIV1Service, and I want to double-check line 314 to confirm.

q12.

frontend hook — `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` (`useMemos` / `useInfiniteMemos`, both calling `memoServiceClient.listMemos`)
client file — `web/src/connect.ts` (`memoServiceClient`, a Connect client over a binary Connect transport with the auth interceptor)
proto RPC — `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`rpc ListMemos(ListMemosRequest) returns (ListMemosResponse)`, HTTP `GET /api/v1/memos`)
backend handler — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`APIV1Service.ListMemos`)
store method — `store/memo.go` (`Store.ListMemos`, delegating to the driver interface in `store/driver.go`)
dialect implementation — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (`DB.ListMemos`; equivalents live in `store/db/postgres/memo.go` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`)

One extra hop worth knowing: the Connect request first lands in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`, where `ConnectServiceHandler.ListMemos` unwraps the Connect envelope and forwards to `APIV1Service.ListMemos`.
